description_en: Queries the Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC) information for a specified domain name
description_zh: 根据传入参数查询指定域名的DNSSEC信息
name: DescribeDomainDnssecInfo

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

The default value is zh
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，取值：

zh：中文
en：英文

默认为zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The domain name. To obtain the domain name, call DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains)
parameters.help_zh:
域名名称。<props="china">可通过调用DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: domain_name

Algorithm.description_en: The algorithm type. This parameter is returned if DNSSEC is enabled
Algorithm.description_zh: 算法类型（如果Dnssec开启则返回）

Digest.description_en: The digest. This parameter is returned if DNSSEC is enabled

DigestType.description_en: The digest type. This parameter is returned if DNSSEC is enabled
DigestType.description_zh: 摘要类型（如果Dnssec开启则返回）

DsRecord.description_en: The Delegation Signer (DS) record. This parameter is returned if DNSSEC is enabled

Flags.description_en: The flags. This parameter is returned if DNSSEC is enabled

KeyTag.description_en: The key tag. This parameter is returned if DNSSEC is enabled
KeyTag.description_zh: 密钥标签（如果Dnssec开启则返回）

PublicKey.description_en: The public key. This parameter is returned if DNSSEC is enabled

Status.description_en:
The status of DNSSEC. Valid values:

ON: Enabled

OFF: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
Dnssec状态：

ON：开启
OFF：关闭
